8.name_native: Prayer (Kitab Al-Salat): Detailed Injunctions about Witr

hadiths.text: Narrated Anas ibn Malik: I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) supplicating Allah in this manner with the palms of his hands and also with their backs upwards
